global_caption: The video contains 10 shots. It is a low-saturation pixel art style Eastern mythological paradise makeup tutorial, primarily using cool gray-pink and jade green tones. Diffused daylight combined with subtle edge backlighting unifies the lighting throughout. The camera movement is delicate and controlled, focusing on clear step-by-step presentation. The mood remains ethereal and calm, with a touch of focused ritualistic atmosphere.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in, using a medium shot at eye level. The young male stands at the center of a jade platform above the sea of clouds. The background features low-saturation pixelated immortal mountains and drifting clouds. Shallow depth of field keeps both the bare face and tools in sharp focus. Soft daylight illuminates skin and jade textures. He slightly raises his hand to signal the start, with a quiet Chinese The camera slowly pushes in.
shot2: Shot 2 cuts hard from the previous shot, switching to a close-up with slight overhead angle. Focus centers on the left cheek and fingertip. Mirror reflection creates foreground-background echo. Primer is gently patted onto the left cheek, its texture quickly diffusing from a small white dot into a thin, misty layer due to body heat. The environment remains the cloud-filled jade platform but is blurred to emphasize the step. Diffused lighting renders skin texture softly visible. Chinese prompt “左颊薄拍妆前乳” appears. The camera performs a very short follow pan.
shot3: Shot 3 cuts hard from the previous shot, transitioning to an extreme close-up overhead view of the under-eye area. Concealer is dotted onto dark areas and rapidly blended with a sponge tip, shifting from wet spots to smooth, skin-adhering finish. The jade-colored mirror frame blurs at the edge of the foreground, creating a sense of enclosure. Lighting remains soft and non-harsh. Chinese prompt “眼下点涂遮瑕并晕开” appears. Guqin plucking and pressing actions synchronize with the motion. The camera slightly tilts down then stabilizes.
shot4: Shot 4 enters via a gentle wipe transition from the previous shot, switching to a close-up at eye level facing the mirror. Focus is on the brow bone and tip of the eyebrow pencil. Foreground shows pixelated highlights on the mirror edge; background clouds drift subtly. The pencil traces a soft misty outline along the natural brow shape, then a brush lightly sweeps over it. Brows shift from loose to defined yet not rigid. Uniform cool gray-pink tone enhances the ethereal quality. Chinese prompt “勾出柔雾眉形” appears. Keyboard harmony gently lifts as the stroke completes. The camera briefly pushes in then stops.
shot5: Shot 5 cuts hard from the previous shot, using an extreme close-up with slight overhead angle on the eye. The outer corner is placed at the right third of the frame. An eyeshadow brush dips into gray-pink pigment and presses it onto the outer corner of the left eye, then gently blends outward. Color transitions from light gray-pink to softer matte layers. Slightly blurred lashes appear in the foreground; mirror and jade texture in the background are darkened to emphasize pigment blending. Chinese prompt “灰粉压在左眼尾” appears. The camera makes an extremely slight horizontal move along the outer eye.
shot6: Shot 6 cuts hard from the previous shot, switching to a close-up at eye level with slight upward angle. Composition uses a diagonal from brow tail to eye corner. A long, fine eyeliner is drawn in one fluid motion, gradually intensifying the local expression from reserved inner corner to sharp outer end. Low-saturation pixel art retains fine edges. Backlight gently outlines lash tips. Chinese prompt “拉出细长眼线” appears. Keyboard tone slightly rises at the stroke’s end. The camera pulls back slightly to reveal full eye shape.
shot7: Shot 7 connects to the previous shot via a soft dissolve, shifting to a close-up at eye level with slight side angle. The cheekbone is positioned at the highlight focal point. Brush moves from temple toward highest point of cheekbone. Powder reflection shifts from matte skin to controlled jade-like shimmer, avoiding excessive brightness that would disrupt the ethereal feel. Cloudy background continues to flow quietly. Diffused light and soft backlight jointly accentuate cheekbone contours. Chinese prompt “轻扫颧骨高光” appears. The camera makes a slight half-circle movement.
shot8: Shot 8 cuts hard from the previous shot, moving to a close-up at eye level on the lips. Frame tightly focuses on the lower half of the face. Blurred reflection of the bronze mirror in the foreground adds depth. Chinese prompt “叠豆沙唇色并柔化边缘” appears.
shot9: Shot 9 connects to the previous shot via a mirror-reflection transition, cutting to a medium-close shot at eye level. The subject faces the bronze mirror, slightly turning head. Left and right sides show unfinished and completed makeup respectively, with richer details on the finished side. Mirror image and real person coexist, creating foreground-background contrast. Differences in brow/eye shape, outer eye gray-pink, cheek glow, and dusty rose lips are immediately apparent. Lighting remains soft and unified. Chinese prompt “镜前对比左右局部妆效” appears. Background The camera smoothly pans to complete the comparative scan.
shot10: Shot 10 connects to the previous shot via fade-in/fade-out, pulling back to a wide shot with slight overhead angle to conclude the video. The young male returns to the center of the jade platform above the sea of clouds. Full makeup appears cold and refined within the low-saturation pixel art paradise. A faint reflection appears on the jade surface. Distant immortal mountains and slowly rolling clouds create depth. Remaining makeup tools and mirror in the foreground indicate tutorial completion. Diffused daylight evenly covers the scene. Edge backlight gently outlines the figure. Final Chinese prompt “完成妆面” appears. The camera slowly pulls back and holds steady.
